county_overrides.override_details: Consolidated government, immigrant hub, active tenant movement. Louisville Metro Human Relations Commission (LMHRC) handles local civil rights complaints with a 1-year filing deadline - longer than state KCHR 180 days for Louisville-specific violations.

Thin infrastructure, high need, remote access. AppalReD is the only civil legal aid provider for most of the 29-county region. Food banks are sparse. Broadband is limited. Intersection of disability (SSDI/SSI), opioid recovery, and housing instability is the predominant presenting situation.
